field_level_diff.method: the harness executes the tool's own source verbatim except its final print, and dumps norm() of every hashed section in full (the tool's DROP set applied by the tool itself); then a recursive walk compares every leaf by value and type (ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED / CHANGED_TYPE / LEN)
field_level_diff.entry_path_shape: every entry is [section, snapshot_index, key] (top level of a snapshot dict)

harness_sources.pr9_dump_norm.py:
"""Executes PR #9's own tools/producer_engine_fingerprint.py source verbatim, except that the
final print(...) statement is replaced by a dump of norm() of every hashed section.
Usage (from <tree>/implementation): python3 <harness>/pr9_dump_norm.py src <out.json>"""
import ast, json, sys
tool = 'tools/producer_engine_fingerprint.py'
src = open(tool, encoding='utf-8').read()
mod = ast.parse(src)
last = mod.body[-1]
assert isinstance(last, ast.Expr) and isinstance(last.value, ast.Call) and getattr(last.value.func, 'id', None) == 'print', 'unexpected tool tail'
mod.body = mod.body[:-1]
out_path = sys.argv[2]
sys.argv = [tool, sys.argv[1]]
ns = {'__name__': '__fp__'}
exec(compile(mod, tool, 'exec'), ns)
norm, h = ns['norm'], ns['h']
sections = {'qgv': ns['q'], 'technical': ns['t'], 'macro': ns['m'], 'leaderboard': ns['lb'], 'portfolio_official_book': ns['book']}
dump = {k: json.loads(json.dumps(norm(v), sort_keys=True, default=str)) for k, v in sections.items()}
dump['_hashes'] = {k: h(v) for k, v in sections.items()}
json.dump(dump, open(out_path, 'w'), sort_keys=True, indent=1)
